CURRENT SCENE:
孟子才十一岁，成为一个哲学家。孟子不是祭拜，而是看政治文章，难怪他成为了哲学家。不过，看过很多政治文章对他害得，他有很多问题。

ITEMS:

[I96] 成为【^】一个哲学家   correction: ∅ → 了   strength: error
  rule card (le_completed, Coherence: temporality (了/着/在)): Use 了 for an action completed in the narrative or for a change of state (了completed). Do not use 了 merely because there is an action verb.  Pattern: <wrong> → <correct>: <action/change> is completed in the story, so it takes 了 (了completed).  Her terms: 了completed, 了completed/change, 着durative, 把
  her past correction: 他成为[+了]哲学家
  her past correction: 他[+后来]成为哲学家
  her past correction: 而是成为[哲学人→哲学家]

[I97] 而是【看】政治文章   correction: 看 → 看到   strength: error
  checker's note: her pattern: 看 -> 看到 (corrected 37/71 in train)
  rule card (perception_look_see, Vocabulary): 看 is “look”; 看到 is “see/catch sight of” and shows that the person actually sees something. Use 看到 when the narrative gives the result of seeing.  Pattern: <wrong> → <correct>: the person actually sees/catches sight of <thing or situation>, so use 看到, not 看.  Her terms: 看look vs.看到see, no了, 看look, 看到see
  her past correction: 而是[学→学习]多文章
  her past correction: 而是[+待在这儿]学多文章 — her note: “不是……而是……” is used to refute something conventional and affirm something unexpected, and to correct something wrong, 搬家is not conventionally related to看文章
  her past correction: 她[一看这→一看到这样] — her note: 看look vs.看到see

[I98] 看过很多政治文章对他【害得】   correction: 害得 → 有害   strength: error
  checker's note: 对他有害 is the correct expression
  rule card (le_completed, Coherence: temporality (了/着/在)): Use 了 for an action completed in the narrative or for a change of state (了completed). Do not use 了 merely because there is an action verb.  Pattern: <wrong> → <correct>: <action/change> is completed in the story, so it takes 了 (了completed).  Her terms: 了completed, 了completed/change, 着durative, 把
  her past correction: 他[写→写了]太多的文章 — her note: 了completed
  her past correction: 害得对孟子[有→受到了]不好的影响 — her note: 害得+Sb.+V.
  her past correction: 他[看得很麻烦的事情→看到很麻烦的情况]

items.explanation: 成为 is a change of state completed in the story, so it takes 了completed: 成为了。
孟子 actually sees the political articles here, so use 看到see, not 看look.
Use 对他有害 for something that is harmful to him. 害得 needs a person plus a following result or action.
